task:
FIX the WRITE rejection bug in city-session.js that causes 37% of session failures.

THE BUG: When a session task says 'BUILD .fastops/X.js', the model tries to WRITE a new file X.js. But the worktree is a copy of the full repo, so if X.js already exists on master (from a prior session), the WRITE guard at line 470 rejects it with 'You must READ X.js before overwriting'. The model never intended to modify the existing file — it wants to create its own version. This causes a death spiral: WRITE rejected → COMMIT fails → DONE fails → repeat until max_turns.

THE FIX (in executeAction, WRITE case, around line 468-473):
1. Extract the target filename from session.task (e.g. if task contains 'BUILD .fastops/foo.js', auto-add '.fastops/foo.js' to session.filesRead at session start)
2. OR: If the file exists but model's new content is a COMPLETE rewrite (not a partial edit), allow it with a warning instead of blocking.
3. BEST: At session creation (around line 892-906), parse the task for BUILD/CREATE targets and pre-populate session.filesRead with those paths.

READ city-session.js lines 460-480 to see the current WRITE guard.
READ city-session.js lines 880-910 to see session creation.
Apply the fix. Test by checking that a WRITE to a file mentioned in the task as BUILD target succeeds without prior READ.

ALSO FIX: Line 403 has a regex bug — /s/.test matches any 's' character, not whitespace. Should be /\s/.test.
